input.quote: 10.8 Headings; Counterparts. The section headings in this Agreement are for reference purposes only and shall not define, limit or affect the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no limitation of liability, exclusion of damages or aggregate-liability language anywhere: the Warranties article (Section 9) and the General Provisions (Section 10) are silent, leaving both Parties exposed to unlimited direct and consequential liability. We insert a new Section 10.9 in the General Provisions setting a mutual cap at the greater of the fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, a mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages, uncapped carve-outs for confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other Party's IP, and confirming that the Company's (Customer's) payment obligations for all amounts due under this Agreement are not "damages" for cap purposes.

ops.text: 10.9 Limitation of Liability. Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000, and neither Party shall be liable to the other for any indirect or consequential damages. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights. The Company's (Customer's) payment obligations for all amounts due under this Agreement are not "damages" for purposes of this Section 10.9.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement caps no liability at all, so we have added a mutual cap at the greater of the fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, with a mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages. Confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnity, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and the Company's (Customer's) payment obligations for all amounts due are not "damages" for cap purposes.
proposal.summary: Insert mutual liability cap (greater of 12 months' fees preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000) with uncapped carve-outs
